turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I have until 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class?
I'm sorry? I didn't come here to talk about me, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
Like, actually tired. Do you sleep? Do you dream?
I ask because you said you came straight from court and you haven't once sounded tired.
I didn't say court, Hale, I came from my office. And how I sound isn't on the table. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook?
